description: Centres de secours du SDIS 64 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SDIS des Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Fire Rescue Centers of the SDIS of the Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Coverage: SDIS des Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal shows the English title as "SDIS 64 Rescue Centers" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SDIS des Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes-1, sdis64, services-dutilite-publiquecommunication, pyrenees-atlantiques-1, services-dutilite-publique. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SHAPEFILE, OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
